CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_SLUGGISH.title: Sluggish
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_SLUGGISH.description: Each stack lowers attack damage dealt by 5%. Whenever an enemy gains 1 Sluggish, it loses 1 random positive buff. At the trigger threshold, enemies lose that many stacks and become Stunned; the player clears Sluggish and becomes Stunned this turn.
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_DEBT.title: Debt
CLOSURE_MOD_KEYWORD_DEBT.description: At end of turn, gain 1 Debt for each negative Energy. At the start of next turn, lose that much Energy.
